description: Multichannel ecommerce platform and API suite for online stores, products, orders, and customer data management.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public apps; custom app access tokens via bearer tokens and HMAC signature verification.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a Shopify Partner account and create development stores and apps for free.
api_notes: Comprehensive coverage of products, variants, inventory, orders, customers, fulfillment, and analytics via GraphQL and REST Admin APIs.
mcp_notes: Shopify provides an official Shopify MCP server (Shopify AI Toolkit / Shopify MCP).
rationale: Shopify offers extensive public GraphQL and REST APIs, free self-serve partner/development accounts, and an official MCP server.

evidence.note: Details API authentication tokens, headers, and access scopes.
Allows signing up as a developer and using the Shopify CLI and Dev Dashboard free.
Outlines GraphQL Admin API, REST Admin API, Storefront API, and webhooks.
References Shopify MCP and Shopify AI Toolkit for AI agents.
